question: Will the 12-month change in U.S. core CPI (CPI-U less food and energy, seasonally adjusted; computed from the index) for July 2024 (the latest monthly reading dated on or before 2024-07-14) be at least 3.60% and below 4.00%?

rule.threshold_basis: rounded lower and upper quartiles of historical moves over the same distance

source: Source: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics
